subject: Lyra Health — platform health, ROI summary & term/tiering options
messages:
From: Marta Ortiz <marta@lyrahealth.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Ishan Rao <ishan@lyrahealth.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 usage + Q1 runway check

Hi Lauren,

Attaching our Q4 token export and a short latency summary — thanks for offering to review. A few quick notes from our side:
- Token spend jumped ~42% over the last quarter, driven mostly by embeddings used in search + weekly reindexing.
- We saw two short latency spikes tied to longer context windows during nightly batch scoring (attached sample in latency_summary_q4.pdf).
- Our team is evaluating a higher-accuracy model for 2028 but worried about cost impact.

Can we schedule a 30-min to talk renewal options and whether a committed path or a dedicated pool makes more sense? We're targeting a term decision by mid-February.

Attachments: lyra_q4_token_report.csv, latency_summary_q4.pdf

Thanks,
Marta Ortiz
Director of ML Ops
Lyra Health

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Marta Ortiz <marta@lyrahealth.ai>, Ishan Rao <ishan@lyrahealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 usage + Q1 runway check

Hi Marta / Ishan — thanks for the files, good context. Quick read-through and initial observations:

Summary:
- 42% spend increase matches heavier embedding cadence and a small uptick in few-shot generation jobs.
- Nightly batch scoring looks latency-sensitive but tolerant of slightly higher tail p99 if overall throughput improves (we can discuss KV caching options).

Two practical renewal paths to consider (high level):
1) Commit increase (12–18 month): modest uplift in committed tokens (~30%) with stepped discounts and a 2-week burst buffer. Keeps you on hosted API, reduces unit cost ~22% in our estimates.
2) Dedicated pool pilot (quarter start): provision a small dedicated GPU pool with mixed-precision quantized variants + prefix caching; target 30–50% per-token cost reduction for generation-heavy workflows and improved p95 latency consistency.

Next steps I suggest: 30-minute call next week for a short ROI walkthrough + a technical split with Ben to scope the dedicated pilot (if you want to see quantization/lower-precision tradeoffs). Priyom will prepare a concise proposal and example term language for each path.

Proposed times: Thu 01/13 11:00am PT or Fri 01/14 9:30am PT. Which works?

Attachments: proposed_tiering_playbook.pdf (internal)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ortiz <marta@lyrahealth.ai>, Ishan Rao <ishan@lyrahealth.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 usage + Q1 runway check — tech notes

Hi Marta / Ishan — jumping in with the technical detail Lauren mentioned. A few concrete ideas (short):

- Mixed routing: route high-fidelity dev/test requests to the larger model; route high-volume embeddings to a smaller, quantized embedding model. Expect ~18–28% immediate token cost reduction depending on split.
- KV / prefix caching: for your nightly scoring, if you can split the static prefix across requests we can cache KV sessions across batches — this reduced token decode by up to 12% in a similar workload.
- Dedicated pilot sizing: recommend 2–4x A100-equivalent for a 30-day pilot to validate tail latency and sustained throughput. We can provide sample stress harness and a cost projection.

I added an estimated cost table for both paths in the HubSpot deal note: https://hubspot.company/DEAL-8473 (see "technical estimate" section). Happy to present these on the call and map numbers back to your monthly burn.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ishan Rao <ishan@lyrahealth.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ortiz <marta@lyrahealth.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jan 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 usage + Q1 runway check

Thanks Lauren and Ben — all helpful. We can do Fri 01/20 9:30am PT for the ROI call.

Request before the call: can Priyom send a short written comparison (2 pages) that lays out: current spend baseline, projected spend under the commit increase, projected spend under the dedicated pilot (including expected latency p95/p99), and a recommended term (12 vs 18 months) with the economic rationale? If you can also include a draft DocuSign-ready addendum (we prefer short amendments), that would accelerate internal approval.

We'll bring our procurement lead to the call for any commercial questions. Looking forward to the pilot numbers.

Best,
Ishan Rao
Head of Platform, Lyra Health
